reviews.title: Ts genuinely pmo🥀
reviews.text: I was trying to make a Wattpad cover and I had discovered that I could use this app to make one. Wattpad suggested this app and I never knew about it, but I was thrilled to hear that I can make an easy cover image for my story. I got the app and then opened it. I could see the templates and thought “This is extremely helpful to me and I will def use this app.” However, once I had opened the app again, I was HIT with a goddamn paywall. $60 for the FIRST year and $84 ANNUALLY!? Worst thing is, you can’t even skip the paywall to use the app. There is no skip button or anything to get the offer off. Like… what? You want me to pay a VERY high price for a subsidiary app of wattpad that just makes covers??? It’s literally such a simple service. You do NOT have to price things for bout a $100 just to make an image for a story. First impression of you btw 🥀
